enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +3: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +3 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Lesser False Life: This item grants the wearer +5 maximum health.
Power II: This item grants the wearer +20 maximum spell points. Favored Souls and Sorcerers gain double spell points from this item.
